world3d-surface-sdf.scope: Hardware pixel, geometry and LOD probes on both devices. No frame timing claim.

wechat-host.scope: WeChat adapter, export and keyboard: host-specific; actual WeChat device and DevTools remain open.

ui-screen.scope: Windows hardware screen suite; physical Fold7 GPU/input with native landscape and scripted sizes/insets.

screen-stack.scope: Node state machine and named UI testing; selected view and modal integration on actual hardware.

gesture.scope: Windows mouse and physical Fold7 two-contact browser input; no human fingers or physical gamepad.

views.scope: Hardware named view interactions and parts. Preserve original official view assertion failure and its separate diagnosis.

paragraph-provider.scope: Windows canvas/CanvasKit comparison and Fold7 canvas-only provider; WeChat remains open.

label-budget.scope: Physical two-backend label/texture budget, warning and lifecycle probes.

tap-title.scope: Physical both-backend child hit, names and vertical titles; font-set editor Node cases; WeChat subpackages unverified on actual host.

tooling.scope: Guide, CLI, static or state schema checks; not a GPU acceptance gate. Original software measurements remain software.

screen-check.scope: Original screen audit on emulated profiles; actual Fold7 modal projection and touch; no physical notch/rotation claim.

portrait-3d.scope: Physical GPU projection and rendered pixels in scripted portrait-shaped container.

scale-off-follow-up.scope: Separately rebuilt latest main for per-view uiScale opt-out. Original #515 hardware observations remain pinned.

provenance.note: Fixture hashes identify the retained reproducer files at the end of each test batch; the private runner was extended during the work. Original report hashes identify the actual saved execution records. Tested engine revisions are explicit.

initialHarnessFailures.reason: CDP discovery timeout while Chrome was backgrounded; no feature checks. Lease released. Normal Chrome foreground restored CDP; no ADB reset.
Example was not in the normal example server allow-list, so readiness assertion timed out. Private server admitted the exact example files; no engine change. Successful subsequent run is separate.
Expected Playwright browser revision not installed; selected existing headless Chromium executable without changing the test or its software-rendering flags.
Shared device lease was owned by another live Node process. No phone feature check ran; the existing lease was preserved.

limits: No WeChat device/DevTools, Safari/iPhone/Firefox, physical gamepad, screen reader or human input. Synthetic safe insets and portrait/tablet parent sizes are separate from the native device viewport. No formal performance, GPU execution or power acceptance. #55 and #92 retain their own requirements.
